item.title: Natural zircon can show unusually strong fire
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Natural zircon may display bright brilliance and rainbow flashes called fire; it is not cubic zirconia.
EXIMUTC view: Ask for mineral identification and treatment disclosure on vivid blue stones.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/zircon-description

item.title: Topaz may display pleochroism
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Topaz can show different colors when viewed along different crystal directions.
EXIMUTC view: Inspect the stone face up and from several angles.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/topaz-description
